items.summary: Redesign the Marketplace home page (frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx) to display dynamic product sections including: featured products, most viewed products, most sold products, and newest designs. The page should automatically reflect newly uploaded products when customers visit without requiring manual refresh.

Add backend methods to support home page product displays: getMostViewedProducts(), getBestSellingProducts(), and getNewestProducts(). Implement view tracking for products and sales tracking to support these queries.

Update the Marketplace home page hero section with a new background and motto text about selling original handcrafted products designed, produced, and sold by the trader. Include promotional elements to attract buyers.
Create a new 'Shop Details' section in the admin Dashboard page (frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx) as a separate tab where the trader can configure contact email address.
Add backend data structure and methods to store and retrieve shop contact details including contact email. Create getShopDetails() and updateShopDetails() methods with admin authentication.
Create React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for fetching shop details (useShopDetails) and updating shop details (useUpdateShopDetails) with admin authentication.

Update the Footer component (frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx) to display the configured contact email from Shop Details as a mailto link in the 'Connect' section. Show 'Contact: email@example.com' or similar label.
